title.en: 5–16 mm Means on the B500S-83D: 5–16 mm beside the Concrete pump article
title.zh: B500S-83D上的5–16毫米指什么：对照「Concrete pump」时，5–16 mm仍在原页

description.en: 5–16 mm Means on the B500S-83D. 5–16 mm stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Concrete pump.
description.zh: B500S-83D上的5–16毫米指什么。5–16 mm仍在目录格子里。插图来自「Concrete pump」。

h1.en: 5–16 mm Means on the B500S-83D: 5–16 mm beside the Concrete pump article
h1.zh: B500S-83D上的5–16毫米指什么：对照「Concrete pump」时，5–16 mm仍在原页

directAnswer.en: The B500S-83D concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists applicable materials as sand and small stone, 5–16 mm. The unit is millimetres. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的 B500S-83D 混凝土泵把适用材料写成砂与小石，5–16 mm。它和电动15的骨料 1–3 cm 不是同一格，也不是电动20的 1–2 cm。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump. The picture shows Concrete boom pump. The B500S-83D concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists applicable materials as sand and small stone, 5–16 mm. The page does not also list a centimetre aggregate row. Do not convert the span into another model's wording and then treat the conversion as a catalogue entry. Delivery hose on the same page says Standard. A trailer pump that lists aggregate in centimetres is a different concrete pump page.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump。画面是Concrete boom pump。河北品锦机械在邢台的 B500S-83D 混凝土泵把适用材料写成砂与小石，5–16 mm。河北品锦机械没有在这一页标出 ≤ 3 cm。以厘米标出骨料的拖泵是另一台混凝土泵的页面。

body.en: The unit is millimetres. 5–16 mm is the shown span. The label is applicable materials. Motor power is 7.5 kW and weight is 280 kg.
body.zh: 它和电动15的骨料 1–3 cm 不是同一格，也不是电动20的 1–2 cm。不要把区间改写成另一型号的措辞，再把换算结果当成目录格。

body.en: It is not the same entry as Electric 15's aggregate of 1–3 cm, and it is not Electric 20's 1–2 cm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list ≤ 3 cm on this page. It is not a pumping-distance row and not a pipe diameter. Those limits stay with B500S-83D.
body.zh: 这台机器的距离仍是 5 m 乘 5 m，材料行并不意味着拖泵的距离。电机功率 7.5 kW，重量 280 kg。

question.en: On this row: Is 5–16 mm the same as 1–3 cm?
question.zh: 5–16 mm 和 1–3 cm 是同一格吗？

answer.en: No. 1–3 cm is shown on other pumps, such as Electric 15. B500S-83D lists 5–16 mm. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump.
answer.zh: 不是。1–3 cm 标出在其他泵上，例如电动15。B500S-83D 标出的是 5–16 mm。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does this page list a pipe diameter in millimetres?
question.zh: 这一页用毫米标出管径吗？

answer.en: It lists delivery hose as Standard, not a millimetre diameter. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump.
answer.zh: 输送胶管标出的是标准，不是毫米管径。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What distance is shown with this material?
question.zh: 和这种材料一起写出的距离是多少？

answer.en: 5 m vertical and 5 m horizontal. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump.
answer.zh: 垂直 5 m，水平 5 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Who publishes the 5–16 mm line?
question.zh: 5–16 mm 这一行是谁公布的？

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery, on the B500S-83D page in Xingtai. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump.
answer.zh: 河北品锦机械，在邢台的 B500S-83D 页面上。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_pump画面里印出的数字。
